# Support

Start with the [reviewer guide](../docs/reviewer-guide.md) and [reproduction instructions](../docs/reproduction.md). Use the [issue forms](https://github.com/thequantumfalcon/homometric-photon-counts/issues/new/choose) for reproducible failures and concrete proof questions. There is no active Discussions channel, response-time commitment, or external scientific support service.

Include the command, software versions, exact model, evidence path, and the smallest relevant output. Remove local account names and private data before sharing logs.
